enabled.title: Enable Streamer Punishments
enabled.description: Requires the Streamer Punishments Streamer.bot actions approved, and one OBS filter per screen effect.

effects.title: Screen effects
effects.description: Each row is one effect: its name, the OBS source it changes, the OBS filter StreamBridge turns on, how many seconds, the StreamBridge points price, and optional Twitch and Kick reward IDs in their own boxes.

exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.description: Each row is one exercise: its name, reps per purchase, the StreamBridge points price, and optional Twitch and Kick reward IDs in their own boxes.

buyCommand.title: Buy command
buyCommand.description: Viewers type !buy pushups. !buy on its own lists everything with its price.

buyPlatforms.title: Chats that can buy with StreamBridge points
buyPlatforms.description: Twitch and Kick use channel point rewards by default; tick them here to also allow !buy with StreamBridge points.

doneCommand.title: Done command (moderators and you)
doneCommand.description: Marks the exercise in progress as done, for example !done or !done pushups.

statusCommand.title: Totals command
statusCommand.description: Shows this month's reps and what is still owed.

controlCommand.title: Moderator control command
controlCommand.description: !punish off stops the current effect and puts the exercise back on the owed list; !punish clear clears owed exercises; !punish next starts the next one.

graceSeconds.title: Grace period before an exercise (seconds)
graceSeconds.description: A countdown shows on the overlay before StreamBridge switches scenes, so you can get somewhere safe in a game you cannot pause.

safeSceneName.title: Scene for exercises
safeSceneName.description: StreamBridge switches here when the grace period ends. Leave empty to stay on the current scene.

returnToPreviousScene.title: Switch back when done
returnToPreviousScene.description: Returns to the scene you were on, unless you already moved away from the exercise scene.

maximumPerStream.title: Most purchases of each exercise per stream
maximumPerStream.description: 0 means no limit. Channel point rewards are already paid, so set the same limit on the reward itself.

maximumEffectQueue.title: Screen effects that can wait in line

onlyWhileLive.title: Only while live
onlyWhileLive.description: Moderators and you can still test while offline.

showOverlay.title: Show the countdown on the overlay
showOverlay.description: Uses this extension's overlay browser source.

startMessage.title: Exercise starts message
startMessage.default: Time for {reps} {name} from {viewer}! A mod types !{done} when they are done.

limitMessage.title: Per-stream limit message
limitMessage.default: {viewer}, {name} is maxed out for this stream ({limit}). Try another punishment.

cooldownMessage.title: Cooldown message
cooldownMessage.default: {viewer}, {name} is cooling down. Try again in {minutes} min.
